from pathlib import Path

p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next((grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != grid[0][0] and sum(row.count(grid[r][c]) for row in grid) >= max(h, w)), None)
    # The grid is partitioned by the non-background divider lines.
    bg = grid[0][0]
    div_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == divider for v in grid[r])]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    row_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for r in div_rows + [h]:
        if start < r: row_ranges.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    col_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for c in div_cols + [w]:
        if start < c: col_ranges.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = row_ranges[0]
    c0, c1 = col_ranges[0]
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    for ra, rb in row_ranges:
        for ca, cb in col_ranges:
            if (ra, ca) == (r0, c0): continue
            for dr, dc, color in shape:
                if ra + dr < rb and ca + dc < cb:
                    out[ra+dr][ca+dc] = color
    return out
'''

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    divider = next(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if grid[r][c] != bg and
                   (all(x == grid[r][c] for x in grid[r]) or all(grid[i][c] == grid[r][c] for i in range(h))))
    div_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == divider for v in grid[r])]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    def intervals(n, cuts):
        result, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts + [n]:
            if start < cut: result.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        return result
    row_ranges, col_ranges = intervals(h, div_rows), intervals(w, div_cols)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = row_ranges[0]
    c0, c1 = col_ranges[0]
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    for ra, rb in row_ranges:
        for ca, cb in col_ranges:
            if (ra, ca) == (r0, c0): continue
            for dr, dc, color in shape:
                if ra + dr < rb and ca + dc < cb:
                    out[ra+dr][ca+dc] = color
    return out
'''
